name: outline-fill-track-text
title: Outline Fill Track Text
description: A rising lead word gives way to an outlined value that fills as one continuous track moves left.
useWhen: A statement should hand focus from a lead word to a large numeric value in one continuous move.
An outlined percentage or metric should gain visual weight without fading.
avoidWhen: The two texts should swap in place: use value-swap.
The value needs to count numerically: use rolling-number or number-wheel.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Value text
variables.description: Large value that is outlined, then fills.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Type size in pixels at a 1920 px wide frame; it scales with the frame.

variables.label: Outline color
variables.description: Color of the outline before the fill.

variables.label: Outline width
variables.description: Outline thickness in pixels at 1920 px wide.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Color of the field behind the text.

variables.label: Glow color
variables.description: Color of the soft glow the lead word rises through.

variables.label: Enter offset
variables.description: How far below its place the lead word starts.

variables.label: Anchor offset
variables.description: Horizontal offset of the lead word from the center.

variables.label: Track distance
variables.description: Distance the track moves left. 0 measures it from the text.

variables.label: Word gap
variables.description: Gap between the lead word and the value.

variables.label: End padding
variables.description: Space kept to the right of the value at the end.

variables.label: Fill duration
variables.description: Frames the fill takes to sweep across (30 fps).
